author: Walewatch
quote: Game crashes a lot and looks terrible. Why did this game take so long to make? The result isn’t worth it

author: Walewatch
quote:
The game has a nice old school vibe, especially with the music. The gameplay is simple but satisfying and the puzzles are decent. The backtracking is maybe borderline excessive without some type of fast travel. 

The biggest problem is multiple soft lock situations that without a patch will render a play through completely dead/useless. It **** to pour hours into a game and be unable to finish because of a soft lock. Also there are bugs needing to be addressed like $ disappearing on death with no chance to reclaim.
